name: fserp-mobile
description: Capacitor Android shell for FSERP (standard SaaS + Adib Filling Station dedicated APK)

scripts.sync: cross-env FSERP_APP_FLAVOR=standard cap sync android && cross-env FSERP_APP_FLAVOR=standard node scripts/apply-flavor.js
scripts.sync:adib: cross-env FSERP_APP_FLAVOR=adib cap sync android && cross-env FSERP_APP_FLAVOR=adib node scripts/apply-flavor.js
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:adib: npm run sync:adib && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
